description: Curated EPS hardening overrides. Generic derivation fills the rest.

REQ-EPS-001.rationale: EPS software architecture allocation. The source bundles architecture, runnables, ports, modes and a fail-safe reaction in one requirement; the hardening pass splits it into atomic parts.
open_issues: Placeholder system parent REQ-EPS-000; confirm the stakeholder/system requirement and ASIL allocation with the EPS owner.

REQ-EPS-010.statement: The system shall compute a torque assist force proportional to the measured driver steering torque from TorqueSensorPrimary using the calibrated base gain.
REQ-EPS-010.design_notes: Assist = driver_torque * base_gain; base_gain is a calibration parameter.

REQ-EPS-014.statement: The system shall add a friction compensation offset to the assist torque based on the rate of change of steering angle using the calibrated friction gain.
REQ-EPS-014.design_notes: Compensation = k_friction * d(angle)/dt; k_friction is a calibration parameter.

REQ-EPS-017.statement: The system shall apply an active damping torque opposing the rate of change of motor speed using the calibrated damping gain.
REQ-EPS-017.design_notes: Damping = k_damp * d(motor_speed)/dt; k_damp is a calibration parameter.

REQ-EPS-018.constraint_rationale: The 5 s adaptation filter is retained as a calibration/implementation constraint for road-camber compensation.
REQ-EPS-018.design_notes: Slow-adapting offset cancellation filter with time constant 5 s.

REQ-EPS-019.statement: The system shall convert the computed assist torque demand to a motor current setpoint using the calibrated motor torque constant.
REQ-EPS-019.design_notes: I_motor = torque_demand / Kt; Kt is a calibration parameter.

REQ-EPS-020.rationale: Torque-demand rate limit for smooth steering response. This is duplicated by REQ-EPS-040; keep one after review.
open_issues: Duplicate 500 Nm/s limit with REQ-EPS-040; consolidate into one requirement and delete the duplicate.
QM requirement adds 1.5x assist below 10 km/h; confirm the ASIL/QM classification because it changes steering torque.
QM requirement adds a lane-keeping correction torque above 100 km/h; confirm the ASIL/QM classification and the yaw-rate reference.
ASIL-B rate limit of 720 deg/s; confirm the mechanical limit and the ASIL allocation.

REQ-EPS-024.statement: The driver torque sensor signal from RP_TorqueSensorPrimary shall be low-pass filtered with the specified filter order and cutoff frequency before use in assist computation.
REQ-EPS-024.constraint_rationale: The filter order and cutoff are retained as a deterministic signal-processing constraint; confirm with the steering-feel calibration.

REQ-EPS-033.rationale: FAIL_SAFE triggers: sensor plausibility, overcurrent, overtemperature, undervoltage, watchdog timeout, CAN timeout. The source uses a single OR condition; it is retained as one reaction requirement.
open_issues: Confirm each FAIL_SAFE trigger and its debounce/reaction time; the source groups six conditions without individual timing.

REQ-EPS-036.rationale: FAIL_SAFE limp-home: 20% of rated assist, 14 A current limit (20% of 70 A).

REQ-EPS-040.rationale: Rate limit of 500 Nm/s enforced every RE_ControlTorque execution, independent of mode.
open_issues: Duplicate 500 Nm/s limit with REQ-EPS-020; consolidate into one requirement and delete the duplicate.

REQ-EPS-042.rationale: Software current limit 70 A; hardware overcurrent protection at 80 A. The 10 A margin is the protection hierarchy.
open_issues: Confirm the 70 A software / 80 A hardware coordination and the >100 ms DTC debounce.

REQ-EPS-043.rationale: Thermal protection: linear derating above 80 C (5% per degree) and disable above 100 C. The source classifies this as ASIL-B while REQ-EPS-033 lists >80 C as a FAIL_SAFE trigger; reconcile.
open_issues: Reconcile the ASIL-B thermal requirement with the ASIL-D FAIL_SAFE trigger at >80 C; define the derating-to-disable transition.

REQ-EPS-044.rationale: Undervoltage protection below 9.0 V for 5 cycles; automatic recovery above 10.5 V.

REQ-EPS-045.rationale: Hardware watchdog trigger every 5 ms in RE_ControlTorque; reset cause is checked on startup.

REQ-EPS-046.rationale: E2E Profile 2 protection on safety-relevant CAN inputs; counter mismatch triggers a CAN-timeout DTC after 2 consecutive failures.
open_issues: Reconcile the 2-failure E2E reaction with REQ-EPS-054 (50 ms / 5 cycles) and define the debounce.

REQ-EPS-047.rationale: Startup RAM/ROM self-test; a failure drives permanent FAIL_SAFE until service.

REQ-EPS-049.rationale: CPU-load monitoring; warning DTC at 80% average over 100 cycles and NVM profiling data.

REQ-EPS-055.rationale: DTC persistence in the same RE_DiagnosticUpdate cycle; confirm whether NvM write can complete in the diagnostic event window.

REQ-EPS-060.rationale: Vehicle-speed CAN input, 0-250 km/h, 0.01 km/h, 10 ms; loss >50 ms triggers CAN timeout.

REQ-EPS-061.rationale: Ignition-status CAN input, boolean, 20 ms, E2E Profile 2.

REQ-EPS-062.rationale: Yaw-rate CAN input, -100 to +100 deg/s, 0.01 deg/s, 10 ms; supports the high-speed stability function.

REQ-EPS-063.rationale: Primary torque sensor: direct SPI, -25 to +25 Nm, 0.01 Nm, 1 ms; filtered before use.

REQ-EPS-064.rationale: Secondary torque sensor: redundant measurement, identical range/resolution, independent SPI bus and physical element.

REQ-EPS-065.rationale: Motor-current demand output, 0-70 A, 0.1 A, 5 ms.

REQ-EPS-066.rationale: EPS status output every 10 ms with mode, DTC count, assist level and health.

REQ-EPS-013.statement: The system shall provide the calibrated maximum assist torque at vehicle speeds of 5 km/h or below to support parking manoeuvres.
REQ-EPS-013.rationale: Low-speed parking assist: provide the calibrated maximum assist capacity at <=5 km/h.
open_issues: Confirm the calibrated maximum assist torque and the 5 km/h boundary with the steering-feel calibration.
